children: Fold Holdings entered a Common Stock Purchase Agreement and related Registration Rights Agreement with Roth Principal Investments for up to $25 million in discretionary equity financing over as long as 36 months following commencement. Sales are priced off VWAP with a 3% discount for market-open and intraday purchases and 5% for pre- and post-market purchases, subject to a $0.10 threshold, a 19.99% Nasdaq exchange cap, and a 4.99% ownership cap. A $500,000 commitment fee will be paid via 10% withholdings from purchase proceeds. To support the registered resale, the company engaged Compass Point Research & Trading as qualified independent underwriter for a $50,000 fee.
